[Claude API Pricing (2026): Per-Million-Token Rates for Every Model > Claude Haiku 5.5 pricing: the 100,000-token price step]

Claude Haiku 5.5 is the one current model priced by prompt length. A request whose prompt is up to 100,000 tokens pays $0.10 per million input tokens and $0.50 per million output tokens. A request whose prompt is over 100,000 tokens pays $0.50 and $2.50 on all of its tokens, not only on the part above the line. Cache writes ($0.125 or $0.625 for 5 minutes, $0.20 or $1 for an hour) and cache reads ($0.01 or $0.05) step up the same way. The prompt length counts every input token in the request, including cache reads and cache writes, and each request is priced on its own, so a conversation that grows past 100,000 tokens pays the higher rate from that turn on while earlier turns keep the price they were billed at (Anthropic pricing docs).
